contact_line: Messages on your private job page
summary: The ordering page is live. Regulars can order ahead and pick a time, and orders land in the café inbox.
delivered:
- Mobile-first ordering page
- Menu with 28 items and prices
- Order emails to the café inbox
- Handover guide
how_to_use:
- Open the guide to change a price or hide a sold-out item
- Check the order inbox from 6:30 am
- Test an order on your phone after any menu change
known_limits:
- No online payment: customers pay at pickup
- Orders need someone to check the inbox
- Menu photos are not included
next_steps:
- **Monthly care plan:** we keep an eye on the page and handle small menu changes each month
- **Payments add-on:** card payments at checkout for a separate fixed price
- **Nothing more:** you keep the page and guide; no follow-up needed
